name: Bookmark
description: A flat, multi-colour bookmark. Ten outlines (classic, tassel with cord hole, pointed, ribbon, page-corner clip, rounded tab, scalloped, star or heart on top, or a custom outline from your own picture), a picture used as a mask (the outline itself, cut through as a stencil or lattice, a flush colour inlay, embossed or debossed), a second picture as a colour overlay, text along or across the strip, a coloured rim, two-tone top layers, colour stripes and tassel beads. Up to 14 colours.
source: inspired by Printables "Cat paw Bookmark" by Dada3Dcraft (674534, 27,044 downloads) and "Minimal Linework Bookmarks" by Bamingo Design (1395937, 12,996 downloads), with Printables "Bookmark (customizable)" by Thomas Mergan (88273, 2,694 downloads) for the parametric strip
